BabyBlues.0: NYUMA YO KUBYARA • UBUZIMA BWO MU MITWE
BabyBlues.1:
Agahinda ko hakiri kubyara (baby blues)
n’ubuzima bwo mu mutwe nyuma yo kubyara
BabyBlues.2: Gusobanukirwa impinduka zishobora kuza mu mutima nyuma yo kubyara no kumenya igihe cyo gushaka ubufasha.
BabyBlues.8: Nyuma yo kubyara, ni ibisanzwe kunyura mu gihe amarangamutima aba yiyongereye. Baby blues akenshi ni iy’igihe gito, ariko agahinda gakomeza cyangwa kiyongera gakwiye kwitabwaho n’umuganga.
BabyBlues.13: Ibifasha mu buzima bwa buri munsi
BabyBlues.14: Baby blues cyangwa agahinda gakabije nyuma yo kubyara?
BabyBlues.19: Baby blues ni igihe cy’impinduka mu marangamutima gishobora kubaho mu minsi mike ya mbere nyuma yo kubyara. Impinduka z’imisemburo, umunaniro, kubura ibitotsi no kumenyera iki gihe gishya byose bishobora gutuma wumva ibintu cyane.
BabyBlues.20: Si ukunanirwa kandi ntibivuze ko uri umubyeyi mubi. Buri wese anyura mu minsi ya mbere nyuma yo kubyara mu buryo bwe.
BabyBlues.22: Baby blues ni ikintu gikunze kubaho nyuma yo kubyara kandi akenshi kigenda gishira ubwacyo mu minsi mike.
BabyBlues.25: Ibyo abantu bumva biratandukanye. Bamwe bumva cyane umunaniro no gukozwa ibintu, abandi bakagira impinduka z’imitekerereze zigaragara cyane.
BabyBlues.27: Kurira byoroshye cyangwa kumva ibintu cyane.
BabyBlues.29: Amarangamutima ashobora kumvikana cyane kandi agahinduka vuba.
BabyBlues.31: Kumva woroheje bishobora gusimburana n’akanya ko kumva umeze neza.
BabyBlues.33: Umunaniro wo mu minsi ya mbere ushobora kongera amarangamutima.
BabyBlues.36: Muri iki gihe, gukenera kuruhuka ni ngombwa cyane. Ibintu bito kandi byoroshye bishobora gutuma iminsi irushaho koroha.
BabyBlues.38: Koresha buri kanya k’ubusa kugira ngo ugarure imbaraga.
BabyBlues.44: Hitamo amafunguro yoroheje kandi ya buri gihe.
BabyBlues.45: “Gusaba ubufasha nyuma yo kubyara ni uburyo bwo kwita ku buzima bwawe n’ubw’umwana wawe.”
BabyBlues.47: Baby blues cyangwa agahinda gakabije nyuma yo kubyara?
BabyBlues.48: Baby blues akenshi ntimara igihe kandi igenda ikira buhoro buhoro. Agahinda gakabije nyuma yo kubyara kaba gatandukanye: gashobora kumara igihe kirekire, kikaba gikomeye, kandi kikagira ingaruka zikomeye ku buzima bwa buri munsi.
BabyBlues.51: Akenshi imara igihe gito, igakira buhoro buhoro mu minsi ikurikira.
BabyBlues.53: Gashobora kumara igihe kirekire, kikiyongera, kandi gukenera ubufasha bw’umuganga.
BabyBlues.56: Ni ngombwa kuvugana n’umuganga niba agahinda katagabanuka, kiyongera, cyangwa gatangiye gutuma ubuzima bwa buri munsi bugorana.
BabyBlues.61: Bigorana kwiyitaho cyangwa kwita ku mwana wawe.
BabyBlues.64: Umubyaza, muganga, umuhanga mu by’imitekerereze cyangwa undi muganga bashobora kukumva, gusuzuma uko ubayeho no kuguha ubufasha bukwiye.
BabyBlues.66: Amarangamutima yo nyuma yo kubyara si igipimo cy’uko uri umubyeyi mwiza. Ufite uburenganzira bwo gukenera kuruhuka, kumvwa no gufashwa.
BabyBlues.69: Baby blues ni ikintu gikunze kubaho nyuma yo kubyara.
BabyBlues.70: Umunaniro n’impinduka z’imisemburo bishobora kugira ingaruka ku mitekerereze.
BabyBlues.71: Ubufasha bw’abagukikije bushobora koroshya iki gihe.
BabyBlues.72: Agahinda gakomeza cyangwa gakomeye gakwiye gusuzumwa n’umuganga.
BabyBlues.73: Iyi nkuru ni iy’amakuru gusa kandi ntisimbura inama z’umuganga zihariye. Niba ufite impungenge cyangwa umutima uremerewe cyane, vugana n’umuganga.
BabyBlues.74: Kwiyitaho nabyo ni igice cy’igihe cyo nyuma yo kubyara.
BabyBlues.75: Agahinda ko hakiri kubyara (baby blues) n’ubuzima bwo mu mutwe nyuma yo kubyara

BabyDevelopment.6: Uko umwana wawe akura, igihembwe ku kindi.
BabyDevelopment.8: Igihembwe cya mbere: iminsi ya mbere
BabyDevelopment.9: Igihembwe cya kabiri: imyakura y’ibyiyumvo iratangira
BabyDevelopment.10: Igihembwe cya gatatu: ibihe bya nyuma
BabyDevelopment.14: Guhera mu cyumweru cya 6, umutima muto utangira gutera. Mu gihe cy’iki gihembwe cya mbere, ingingo z’ingenzi zigenda zikorwa buhoro buhoro.
BabyDevelopment.16: Gutera k’umutima w’umwana ni kimwe mu bimenyetso bya mbere bigaragara kuri ultrasound, akenshi ni akanya k’ingenzi mu kwita ku buzima bwawe.
BabyDevelopment.17: Hafi y’icyumweru cya 20, akenshi ushobora kumva ibyo umwana akora bwa mbere. Ni nabwo ibyiyumvo bitangira gukura.
BabyDevelopment.18: Guhera mu gihembwe cya 3, umwana yongera ibiro vuba kandi buhoro buhoro afata umwanya wo kuvuka.
BabyDevelopment.19: Umuvuduko w’ikura uratandukanye ku mwana ku wundi: ibi ni ibigereranyo rusange gusa.
BabyDevelopment.20: Guhera ku byumweru 6: umutima utangira gutera
BabyDevelopment.21: Hafi y’ibyumweru 20: ibikorwa bya mbere biraboneka
BabyDevelopment.23: Hafi y’ibyumweru 28: amaso agenda afunguka buhoro buhoro
BabyDevelopment.24: Umwana “yumva byose” kuva mbere: kumva ntibikura neza kugeza mu gihembwe cya 2
BabyDevelopment.25: Imiterere y’inda igaragaza igitsina cy’umwana: nta bimenyetso bya siyansi bibishyigikira
BabyDevelopment.26: Umwana ukora cyane aba afite ubuzima bwiza kurusha abandi: uko umwana akora biratandukanye cyane
BabyDevelopment.28: Buri cyiciro cy’ikura ry’umwana gikurikira umuvuduko wacyo; gusuzumwa n’umuganga buri gihe bifasha kwemeza ko byose bigenda neza.

BasalTemperature.0: UBURUMBUKE • UBUSHYUHE BW’UMUBIRI BWA BURI GITONDO
BasalTemperature.1:
Gukurikirana
ubushyuhe bw’umubiri bwa buri gitondo
BasalTemperature.6: Uburyo bworoshye bwo kwemeza, nyuma yaho, ko ovulation yabaye.
BasalTemperature.8: Ubushyuhe bw’umubiri bwa buri gitondo ni iki?
BasalTemperature.15: Ubushyuhe bw’umubiri bwa buri gitondo ni ubushyuhe bw’umubiri wawe uruhutse rwose, mbere yo gukora ikintu cyose. Buhinduka gake cyane mu gihe cy’ukwezi, bitewe n’imisemburo yawe.
BasalTemperature.16: Bupimwa buri gitondo, mbere yo guhaguruka, buri gihe mu isaha imwe no gukoresha thermometer imwe.
BasalTemperature.18: Koresha buri gihe thermometer imwe, byaba byiza ari iyagenewe ubu bupimo (ipima neza, kugeza ku gice cy’ikigereranyo).
BasalTemperature.20: Pima mu isaha ihoraho, mbere yo guhaguruka, nyuma yo gusinzira nibura amasaha 3 nta kubyuka.
BasalTemperature.22: Andika igisubizo ako kanya, mbere yo guhaguruka cyangwa kuvuga.
BasalTemperature.23: Ubushyuhe bw’umubiri bwa buri gitondo buzamuka gake (0.2 kugeza kuri 0.5°C) nyuma ya ovulation, bitewe na progestérone, kandi bugaguma hejuru kugeza imihango yawe ikurikira.
BasalTemperature.25: Buba hasi mu gice cya mbere cy’ukwezi, bukazamuka nyuma ya ovulation bugahagarara aho — ishusho igaragara neza nyuma y’iminsi myinshi yo gupima gusa.
BasalTemperature.30: Urugendo rurerure vuba aha rwahinduye amasaha
BasalTemperature.31: Ubu si uburyo bwo guhanura ahubwo ni uburyo bwo kwemeza: bugufasha gusobanukirwa neza ukwezi kwawe, ovulation imaze kuba — si ukuyibanziriza.
BasalTemperature.32: Kubukurikirana wenyine mu kwezi kumwe cyangwa kubiri akenshi ntibihagije: ishusho igaragara iyo bisubiyemo.
BasalTemperature.34: Nta zamuka ry’ubushyuhe rigaragara mu mezi menshi yuzuye
BasalTemperature.35: Ubushyuhe buguma buhindagurika cyane nubwo upima neza
BasalTemperature.36: Ufite ibibazo ku buruba bwawe iyi gukurikirana yonyine idashobora gusubiza
BasalTemperature.38: Guhuza ubushyuhe bw’umubiri bwa buri gitondo no kwitegereza ururenda rwo mu nkondo y’umura cyangwa ibipimo bya ovulation bitanga ishusho yuzuye y’ukwezi kwawe.
BasalTemperature.39: Ubushyuhe bw’umubiri bwa buri gitondo buzamuka gake (0.2 kugeza kuri 0.5°C) nyuma ya ovulation, bitewe na progestérone.
BasalTemperature.40: Bupimwa buri gitondo, mbere yo guhaguruka, buri gihe mu isaha imwe no gukoresha thermometer imwe.
BasalTemperature.41: Ubu si uburyo bwo guhanura ahubwo ni uburyo bwo kwemeza: bugufasha gusobanukirwa neza ukwezi kwawe.
BasalTemperature.42: Kubuhuza n’ibindi bimenyetso (ururenda rwo mu nkondo y’umura, ibipimo bya ovulation) bitanga ishusho yuzuye.
BasalTemperature.43: Ibikubiyemo by’amakuru gusa. Iyi nkuru ntisimbura inama z’umuganga zihariye. Niba ufite ikibazo, saba umuganga kukuyobora.
BasalTemperature.44: Gukurikirana ubushyuhe bw’umubiri bwa buri gitondo — AWA

BirthControlPills.6: Uko ikinini gikora, uko kinyobwa buri munsi, n’ibyiza n’imbibi zacyo by’ingenzi.
BirthControlPills.12: Ikinini kirimo imisemburo — estrogène na/cyangwa progestine, bitewe n’ubwoko — ikora cyane cyane irinda cyangwa ihagarika ovulation. Inahindura ururenda rwo mu nkondo y’umura, bigatuma intanga zigorana kunyuramo.
BirthControlPills.14: Hari ubwoko bunyuranye bw’ibinini, harimo ibivanze n’ibifite progestine yonyine. Ibiyigize n’uburyo bunyobwa bishobora gutandukana.
BirthControlPills.15: Kunywa buri gihe ni ingenzi. Bitewe n’ubwoko bw’ikinini, ibyo gukora nyuma yo kwibagirwa ikinini bishobora gutandukana — bityo ni ngombwa gusoma urupapuro rw’amabwiriza rw’umuti wawe.
BirthControlPills.16: Hitamo isaha yoroshye kwibuka (ifunguro, igihe cyo kuryama...)
BirthControlPills.17: Koresha ikwibutsa cyangwa porogaramu nibiba ngombwa
BirthControlPills.18: Bika urupapuro rw’amabwiriza hafi mu gihe ufite ikibazo
BirthControlPills.19: Nk’uburyo bwose bwo kwirinda inda, ikinini gifite ibyiza ariko kinafite imbibi zimwe ukwiye kumenya mbere yo kugihitamo.
BirthControlPills.22: Kigabanya cyane ibyago byo gutwita iyo gikoreshejwe neza
BirthControlPills.23: Gishobora gutuma imihango isanzwe kandi yoroshye kuyiteganya
BirthControlPills.24: Gishobora kugabanya ububabare n’amaraso ku bantu bamwe
BirthControlPills.25: Gishobora guhindurwa cyangwa gusimburwa niba kitakubereye
BirthControlPills.28: Gisaba kunywa buri gihe bitewe n’ubwoko bw’ikinini
BirthControlPills.29: Kwibagirwa ikinini bishobora kugabanya ubushobozi bwacyo
BirthControlPills.30: Abantu bamwe bashobora kugira ingaruka mbi
BirthControlPills.31: Ntikirinda indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina (STIs)
BirthControlPills.33: Ikinini ni uburyo bw’imisemburo bwiza bwo kwirinda inda iyo gikoreshejwe neza. Kukinywa buri gihe, ingaruka mbi zishobora kubaho, no kutarinda STIs ni ibintu by’ingenzi kumenya.
BirthControlPills.34: Niba utekereza uburyo bwo kwirinda inda cyangwa uburyo ukoresha butakubereye, ntutinye kuvugana na muganga, umubyaza, cyangwa undi muganga.
BirthControlPills.35: Gusobanukirwa ikinini cyo kwirinda inda — AWA

BoneHealth.6: Impamvu menopause yongera ibyago bya osteoporose, n’uko wakwita ku magufwa yawe buri munsi.
BoneHealth.14: Estrogène ifasha mu buryo busanzwe kurinda ubucucike bw’amagufwa mu kugabanya umuvuduko w’ivugurura ryayo. Igabanuka rya estrogène muri menopause ryihutisha gutakaza amagufwa, cyane cyane mu myaka ya mbere nyuma y’uko imihango ihagarara.
BoneHealth.15: Osteopénie ivuga ubucucike bw’amagufwa buri hasi y’ibisanzwe, bitarageza ku rwego rwa osteoporose. Osteoporose ni ugucika intege kw’amagufwa gukomeye kurushaho kongera ibyago byo kuvunika, cyane cyane iyo ugwiriye.
BoneHealth.17: Amagambo yombi asobanura gutakaza ubucucike bw’amagufwa, si ukuvunika kwabaye — ni ikimenyetso cyo kwirinda, si impamvu yo guhangayika.
BoneHealth.18: Iri suzuma ridatera ububabare rupima ubucucike bw’imyunyu ngugu mu magufwa. Rishobora gutangwa bitewe n’imyaka yawe, amateka yawe n’ay’umuryango wawe, cyangwa ibindi byago byamenyekanye hamwe na muganga wawe.
BoneHealth.19: Calcium (ibikomoka ku mata, imboga zifite amababi)
BoneHealth.21: Imyitozo ikoresha uburemere bw’umubiri (kugenda, imyitozo y’imbaraga)
BoneHealth.25: Kunywa itabi ubu cyangwa mu bihe byashize
BoneHealth.26: Umubiri woroshye cyane cyangwa gukora imyitozo mike cyane
BoneHealth.28: Kugira kimwe cyangwa byinshi muri ibi ntibivuze ko uzagira osteoporose — biri ahanini kugira ngo bifashe mu biganiro na muganga wawe ku gusuzumwa gashobora kubaho.
BoneHealth.30: Calcium, vitamine D, n’imyitozo ikoresha uburemere bw’umubiri bikomeza kuba ingeso za buri munsi zifasha cyane kubungabunga imbaraga z’amagufwa igihe kirekire.
BoneHealth.31: Kwita ku buzima bw’amagufwa yawe — AWA

Breastfeeding.7: Iminsi ya mbere yo konsa ni igihe cyo kwiga ku mwana no ku mubyeyi. Kwegera ibere, injyana, uko wicara no kwitegereza bifasha buhoro buhoro kubona ibikorohera.
Breastfeeding.16: Konsa bishyirwa mu mikorere buhoro buhoro. Amasaha ya mbere, hanyuma iminsi ya mbere, biha umwana n’umubyeyi igihe cyo kwiga hamwe.
Breastfeeding.20: Gukozanyaho uruhu n’uruhu no kwegera ibere hakiri kare bishobora gufasha konsa gutangira neza.
Breastfeeding.22: Umwana ashobora konka kenshi. Ni ibisanzwe ko injyana ihinduka.
Breastfeeding.24: Konsa buhoro buhoro bihinduka injyana isangiwe n’umwana n’umubyeyi.
Breastfeeding.26: Amashereka agenda ahinduka buhoro buhoro hakurikijwe ibyo umwana akeneye.
Breastfeeding.28: Aho kwibanda ku isaha gusa, bishobora gufasha kwitegereza ibimenyetso by’uko umwana akangutse, konka, n’uko yihagarika.
Breastfeeding.30: Uruhinja rushobora gusaba konka kenshi, rimwe na rimwe incuro 8 kugeza kuri 12 mu masaha 24.
Breastfeeding.32: Umwana ashobora kwimuka, gufungura umunwa, cyangwa gushaka ibere atangiye kumva ashonje.
Breastfeeding.34: Umubare w’impuzu zitose n’izanduye ni kimwe mu bintu byo kwitegereza buri munsi.
Breastfeeding.36: Uko wicaye neza no kwegera ibere neza bishobora koroshya konsa. Niba ububabare ari bwinshi cyangwa bukomeza, umuganga ashobora kugenzura uko wicaye n’uko umwana yegereye ibere.
Breastfeeding.38: Igenzura ryoroshye mu gihe cyo konsa
Breastfeeding.42: Umwana afatwa hafi y’umubiri, umutwe we ukaba uri mu mwanya woroshye.
Breastfeeding.44: Tegereza umunwa wuguruye bihagije mbere yo guha umwana ibere.
Breastfeeding.46: Kwegera ibere neza ntibikwiye gutera ububabare bukomeye cyangwa bukomeza.
Breastfeeding.48: Ibikorwa byo konka no kumira bishobora kugaragara mu gihe cyo konsa.
Breastfeeding.50: Nta mpamvu yo gutegereza ko ingorane zikomera. Umuganga wize ashobora gufasha kugenzura uko wicaye, uko umwana yegereye ibere, cyangwa ibyo umwana akeneye.
Breastfeeding.52: Ashobora kugufasha mu konsa kwa mbere.
Breastfeeding.56: Ashobora gufasha mu gihe kwegera ibere bigoye.
Breastfeeding.58: Iminsi ya mbere ishobora gutandukana cyane. Injyana yo konsa n’ingano y’amashereka bishobora guhinduka buhoro buhoro uko igihe kigenda. Niba hari ikikubabaza, saba inama umuganga.
Breastfeeding.60: Konsa kwa mbere ni igihe cyo kwiga ku mwana no ku mubyeyi.
Breastfeeding.62: Uko wicaye neza no kwegera ibere neza ni ingenzi.
Breastfeeding.63: Kwitegereza ibimenyetso by’umwana bifasha kurusha gushaka gahunda ihamye rwose.
Breastfeeding.64: Umubyaza cyangwa umujyanama mu konsa ashobora kugufasha mu ngorane za mbere.
Breastfeeding.65: Ibikubiyemo by’amakuru gusa. Iyi nkuru ntisimbura inama zihariye z’umuganga.

CervicalMucus.0: UBURUMBUKE • URURENDA RWO MU NKONDO Y’UMURA
CervicalMucus.1:
Kwitegereza
ururenda rwo mu nkondo y’umura
CervicalMucus.6: Ikimenyetso gisanzwe kandi k’ubuntu cyo kumenya igihe cy’uburumbuke bwawe.
CervicalMucus.8: Ururenda rwo mu nkondo y’umura ni iki?
CervicalMucus.15: Ni ibintu bisanzwe bikorwa n’inkondo y’umura. Ururenda rwo mu nkondo y’umura rurahinduka mu miterere mu gihe cy’ukwezi, bitewe na estrogène na progestérone.
CervicalMucus.19: Rurushaho kuba rwinshi, rwijimye kandi rwomekana.
CervicalMucus.21: Rusobanutse, rurambuka kandi rworoshye, nk’umweru w’igi ritetse.
CervicalMucus.23: Rugwa neza, rudasobanutse, cyangwa ruba rukeya cyane.
CervicalMucus.30: Itegereze uko rusa n’uko rumeze ukoresheje impapuro z’isuku cyangwa intoki zisukuye, mu isaha imwe buri munsi, kandi wandike ibyo ubonye.
CervicalMucus.33: Uburyo bwo kwirinda inda bukoresha imisemburo cyangwa imiti imwe
CervicalMucus.35: Buri wese afite imiterere ye, kandi kumenya iyawe bisaba imyitozo mu mezi menshi. Kwitegereza iri hinduka buri munsi, hamwe n’ibindi bimenyetso, bigufasha kumenya neza igihe cy’uburumbuke bwawe — ariko ntibisimbura inama z’umuganga niba ufite impungenge.
CervicalMucus.37: Guhuza ururenda rwo mu nkondo y’umura n’ubushyuhe bw’umubiri bwa buri gitondo cyangwa ibipimo bya ovulation bitanga ishusho yuzuye y’ukwezi kwawe.
CervicalMucus.38: Ururenda rwo mu nkondo y’umura rurahinduka mu miterere mu gihe cy’ukwezi, bitewe na estrogène na progestérone.
CervicalMucus.39: Ovulation iri hafi, ruba rusobanutse, rurambuka kandi rworoshye, nk’umweru w’igi ritetse.
CervicalMucus.40: Kwitegereza iri hinduka buri munsi, hamwe n’ibindi bimenyetso, bigufasha kumenya neza igihe cy’uburumbuke bwawe.
CervicalMucus.41: Kumenya imiterere yawe bisaba imyitozo n’amezi menshi yo kwitegereza.
CervicalMucus.42: Ibikubiyemo by’amakuru gusa. Iyi nkuru ntisimbura inama z’umuganga zihariye. Niba ufite ikibazo, saba umuganga kukuyobora.
CervicalMucus.43: Kwitegereza ururenda rwo mu nkondo y’umura — AWA

ChildbirthPrep.6: Inkingi eshatu zo kwegera umunsi ukomeye wizeye kurushaho.
ChildbirthPrep.15: Igikapu cy’ibitaro cyiteguye mu kwezi kwa 8
ChildbirthPrep.16: Amasomo yo kwitegura kubyara agufasha gusobanukirwa ibyiciro by’ibise n’uburyo bwo guhumeka buzagufasha ku munsi ukomeye.
ChildbirthPrep.17: Gutegura igikapu cy’ibitaro mu kwezi kwa 8 bikurinda guhangayika mu minota ya nyuma. Akenshi kirimo:
ChildbirthPrep.20: Ibikoresho by’isuku n’ibitambaro byo nyuma yo kubyara
ChildbirthPrep.22: Ibyo ukunda ku bijyanye no kugabanya ububabare
ChildbirthPrep.23: Abo wifuza ko baba bahari mu gihe cy’ibise
ChildbirthPrep.24: Ibyo witeze ku gukozanyaho uruhu n’uruhu
ChildbirthPrep.25: Gahunda yoroshye yo kubyara igufasha kubwira abaganga ibyo wifuza, ukomeza kuba witeguye: uko bigenda mu by’ukuri bishobora guhinduka bitewe n’uko bimeze.
ChildbirthPrep.27: Kwitegura ntibivuze kugenzura byose: ahanini ni ukwiha uburyo bwo kwegera umunsi ukomeye wizeye kurushaho kandi udashidikanya cyane.

ChooseHormonalMethod.6: Ibibazo bikwiye wibaza kugira ngo ubone uburyo bwo kwirinda inda buhuye n’ubuzima bwawe bwa buri munsi, ibyo ukeneye n’ibyo uteganya.
ChooseHormonalMethod.13: Nta buryo bumwe bwiza bwo kwirinda inda kuri bose. Mbere yo guhitamo uburyo, bishobora gufasha gutekereza ku ngeso zawe, ibyo ukunda, uko umubiri wawe uburyakira n’ibyo uteganya.
ChooseHormonalMethod.14: Umubiri wanjye witwara ute ku misemburo?
ChooseHormonalMethod.15: Nkeneye gukora ikintu buri munsi cyangwa buri cyumweru, cyangwa igisubizo kimara igihe kirekire?
ChooseHormonalMethod.16: Mfite gahunda yo gutwita mu gihe giciriritse?
ChooseHormonalMethod.17: Ingengo y’imari yanjye ni iyihe, kandi ubu buryo bwo kwirinda inda bworohera bute kubona?
ChooseHormonalMethod.18: Abantu babiri bashobora guhitamo uburyo butandukanye kandi bombi bakaba bahisemo neza ibihuye n’imiterere yabo. Guhitamo neza biterwa cyane cyane n’uko ushaka gukoresha uburyo bwo kwirinda inda n’ibyo ushaka.
ChooseHormonalMethod.20: Uburyo bugaragara bwiza ku mpapuro si ngombwa ko ari bwo bworoshye cyangwa bukubereye buri munsi.
ChooseHormonalMethod.21: Kugereranya amahitamo menshi, ushobora kureba ibintu bitandukanye. Intego si ukumenya byose mu mutwe, ahubwo ni ukumenya icyo gifite agaciro kuri wowe.
ChooseHormonalMethod.23: Uburyo bumwe busaba gukora ikintu buri munsi, ubundi bugasaba kwitabwaho buri cyumweru, cyangwa gake cyane.
ChooseHormonalMethod.25: Ingaruka wumva zishobora gutandukana ku muntu ku wundi. Ni ngombwa kwitegereza uko umubiri wawe witwara no kubivuga niba hari ikikubangamiye.
ChooseHormonalMethod.27: Niba wizeye gutwita vuba, igihe cyo gukoresha n’uko uburumbuke bugaruka nyuma yo guhagarika bishobora kuba mu byo muganiraho.
ChooseHormonalMethod.29: Ubushobozi ntibushingiye gusa ku buryo bwahiswemo, ahubwo no ku kububukoresha neza kandi buri gihe.
ChooseHormonalMethod.31: Itandukaniro rimwe ry’ingenzi hagati y’uburyo ni incuro ukwiye gutekereza ku buryo bwawe bwo kwirinda inda.
ChooseHormonalMethod.43: Uburyo bw’imisemburo bushobora kumvikana ukundi ku muntu ku wundi. Bamwe babona impinduka mu kwezi kwabo, mu maraso, cyangwa izindi ngaruka mbi. Ibi ntibivuze ko uburyo budakubereye, ariko bikwiye kwitabwaho.
ChooseHormonalMethod.45: Niba ingaruka ari nyinshi, ikomeza, cyangwa idasanzwe, ntukomeze wenyine n’ibibazo byawe. Muganga, umubyaza cyangwa undi muganga bashobora kugufasha kumenya niba ukomeza, uhindura, cyangwa uhindura uburyo.
ChooseHormonalMethod.47: Gahunda zawe zo gutwita nazo zishobora kugira ingaruka ku guhitamo. Niba ushaka kwirinda gutwita imyaka myinshi, uburyo bumara igihe kirekire bushobora gutekerezwaho. Niba utekereza gutwita vuba, andi mahitamo ashobora guhura neza n’igihe cyawe.
ChooseHormonalMethod.49: Kuvuga ku ngamba zawe zo gutwita, nubwo ziri kure cyangwa zidasobanutse, bifasha umuganga kuyobora neza ikiganiro.
ChooseHormonalMethod.50: Gahunda y’isuzuma igufasha gupima ibyiza, imbogamizi n’ibishobora kubuza kuri buri buryo. Ushobora gutegura ibibazo bike mbere kugira ngo utibagirwa ikintu cy’ingenzi.
ChooseHormonalMethod.55: Nkore iki nibwibagirwa, niba bwimutse aho bwari buri, cyangwa niba nshaka kubuhagarika?
ChooseHormonalMethod.56: Ubu buryo buhuye na gahunda zanjye zo gutwita?
ChooseHormonalMethod.58: Umubyaza cyangwa muganga ashobora kuzirikana amateka yawe y’ubuzima, imiti, ibyo ukunda n’uko ubaho mbere yo kugusaba uburyo.
ChooseHormonalMethod.60: Hitamo uburyo buhuye n’ubuzima bwawe bwa buri munsi.
ChooseHormonalMethod.61: Zirikana uko umubiri wawe ububyakira n’ibyo ukunda.
ChooseHormonalMethod.62: Tekereza ku ngamba zawe zo gutwita n’igihe cyawe.
ChooseHormonalMethod.63: Saba inama umuganga niba utazi neza.
ChooseHormonalMethod.65: Uburyo bwiza si ngombwa ko ari ubugaragara nk’ubworoshye cyangwa ubukunzwe cyane. Ni ubuhuje n’imiterere yawe, ibyo ukeneye n’ibyo ukunda, nyuma y’ikiganiro cyuzuye n’umuganga.
ChooseHormonalMethod.66: Iyi nkuru ni iy’amakuru gusa kandi ntisimbura inama z’umuganga zihariye.

ConceptionLifestyle.1:
Ingeso z’ubuzima
n’urugendo rwawe rwo gusama
ConceptionLifestyle.6: Ingeso zoroshye zishobora gushyigikira urugendo rwawe — nta gahato.
ConceptionLifestyle.12: Ingeso zimwe zoroshye z’ubuzima zishobora gushyigikira urugendo rwo gusama, nubwo zidashobora kwemeza igisubizo zonyine.
ConceptionLifestyle.17: Guhangayika igihe kirekire bishobora kugira ingaruka ku ngano y’imisemburo no, ku bagore bamwe, ku buryo ukwezi gusanzwe. Kwiha akanya ko gutuza ni igice cy’urugendo.
ConceptionLifestyle.19: Kwifuza “gukora byose neza” bishobora kuba isoko yo guhangayika: gushaka ingeso nziza muri rusange birahagije, nta gushaka ko byose biba byuzuye.
ConceptionLifestyle.20: Itabi, rishobora kugira ingaruka ku buruba bw’abashakanye bombi
ConceptionLifestyle.22: Imyitozo ya siporo ikomeye kandi imara igihe kirekire, ishobora ku rundi ruhande kugabanya uburumbuke
ConceptionLifestyle.23: Isukari nyinshi itunganyijwe, ishobora kubangamira ingano y’imisemburo
ConceptionLifestyle.25: Ingeso ziringaniye muri rusange, nta bwinshi cyangwa gushaka ko byose biba byuzuye, ni zo nkunga nziza ya buri munsi.
ConceptionLifestyle.26: Ingeso z’ubuzima n’urugendo rwo gusama — AWA

ConceptionStart.6: Ibyingenzi byo gutangira urugendo rwawe rwo gusama wizeye.
ConceptionStart.12: Intambwe ya mbere ifasha cyane ni ukumenya igihe cy’uburumbuke bwawe ukoresheje ukwezi kwawe: uburebure bw’ukwezi, ibimenyetso by’umubiri, kandi, nibiba ngombwa, ibikoresho byo gukurikirana nk’ibipimo bya ovulation cyangwa ubushyuhe bw’umubiri bwa buri gitondo.
ConceptionStart.13: Kugirana imibonano mpuzabitsina buri gihe, buri minsi 2 kugeza kuri 3, bikubiyemo mu buryo busanzwe igihe cy’uburumbuke bwinshi nta gutegura gukabije.
ConceptionStart.14: Nta mpamvu yo kwiyemeza umunsi wa ovulation gusa
ConceptionStart.15: Injyana ihoraho yoroshye kuyikomeza kurusha gahunda ikaze
ConceptionStart.16: Imibereho myiza y’abashakanye nayo ni ingenzi muri iki gihe
ConceptionStart.17: Abashakanye benshi basama mu mezi 12 nyuma yo guhagarika uburyo bwo kwirinda inda. Iki gihe gitandukana bitewe n’ibintu byinshi byihariye kuri buri wese.
ConceptionStart.19: Nyuma y’amezi 12 (cyangwa amezi 6 nyuma y’imyaka 35), birakwiye kubona umuganga ngo agusuzume, nubwo bitavuze ko hari ikibazo.
ConceptionStart.21: Kumenya ukwezi kwawe, gukomeza injyana isanzwe, no kwihangana ni inkingi eshatu zo gutangira uru rugendo utuje.
